title: Large whales killed by commercial whaling

source.name: Historical whaling catch database
source.publisher: International Whaling Commission, via Rocha et al. (2014), 'Emptying the Oceans', Marine Fisheries Review

notes: An estimated 2.9 million large whales were killed by industrial commercial whaling 1900-1999, per the IWC's historical catch database as compiled in Rocha, Clapham & Ivashchenko (2014). The global moratorium on commercial whaling took effect in 1986; legal commercial whale kills under it are recorded as zero.
